title: William Blake: Called Mad in His Lifetime, Now a Giant of English Poetry | 269 Years Ago

lines: In his lifetime, people called him mad. Today, he's a national treasure!

scenes.chapter: Chapter 2  A secret from a dream
lines: Then his beloved younger brother Robert died.
Blake said Robert showed him in a dream a new way to print:
Blake said Robert came to him in a dream and showed him a new way to print:
poems and pictures etched together on copper,
then painted by hand, page by page, with his wife Catherine.
